fields.summary_ko.0: AAPL received a BUY rating with a target price of $398.25 (15.77% upside vs. current price of $343.99), showing nine consecutive earnings beats and broad-based growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue of $109.42 billion (up 16.4% year-over-year), EPS of $2.02 exceeded consensus of $1.89, and services revenue grew to $30.7 billion (up 12%).
fields.summary_ko.2: Margin pressure concerns exist from rising memory prices, with September quarter gross margin guidance of 47–48% including one-time tariff refunds of approximately 2 percentage points.
